entities.summary: Avery Milton Williamson is an American former professional football player who was a linebacker in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Kentucky Wildcats and was selected by the Tennessee Titans in the fifth round of the 2014 NFL draft. Williamson was also a member of the New York Jets, Pittsburgh Steelers, and Denver Broncos.
